item.tib: tshe dbang drag khros kyi dgongs rim
item.coloph: de ltar dzA tha'i drag po'i gzhung don gyis (gyi) dgongs rim 'di yang*/ shin tu dgos gnad che ba'i blos bskul ba dang /ma zad dad ldan bra bo rgya mtsho (mtshos) shog dkar lha rdzas kyi (kyis) drangs te/ bka' chos gang rigs phab dgos pas gsung bskul byung ba sogs kyi chad (ched) du/ sems dpa'i ming rlom gshen sprul thugs rje nyi mas gshen gyi bla brang su (du) lung rigs nas bsdus te sbyar ba'o/ dge des bon bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
